Operational characteristics 2.3.1.2 Analysis of Load Metrics The load metrics defined in section 2.1.1 were evaluated for the spring evaluation period. Figure 19 shows the time-varying metrics determined from the M&V data while Table 11 lists the average of each energy metric for each of the four operating modes. Similar to results from the summer evaluation period, it is apparent that space cooling was required most of the time.
